content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 5 of 5 planned. Sets: 58 (last week 58).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last week 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 4 sets this week
- Overhead Press: 45 kg x 8 (last week 42.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 5.9%, 8 sets this week
- Lat Pulldown: 55 kg x 10 (last week 52.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4.8%, 6 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 80 kg x 8; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8; Barbell Back Squat 100 kg x 6; Overhead Press 45 kg x 8; Lat Pulldown 55 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle per week (range 10-20 for chest, back, legs, shoulders, glutes): chest 14 (last week 14), shoulders 14 (last week 14), triceps 4 (last week 4), back 14 (last week 14), biceps 4 (last week 4), legs 8 (last week 8).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Build muscle".
The user's note for this week: none.
Rules that fired. Advise only on these, by id:
- id "low_volume:legs", priority 50, data {"sets":8,"perWeek":8,"previousPerWeek":8,"target":10,"addSets":2}. Advice: Add addSets sets (from the data) each week for that muscle, which brings it to 10 a week, spread over sessions the user already does.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. items: advice for at most 3 of the fired rules, most important first: usually by priority, but the goal or the note may change the order. A deload, if it fired, is always included and first. Each action is one or two short sentences saying exactly what to do next week, with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
